original.target_description: Anderson and Grice (2009): pinto-bean good/bad classification, single-sample t test versus chance (25 of 50 pairs). The original is common to the later tiles/spheres/beans/pooled replication targets.

n.exclusions: Two of 28 excluded: one did not evaluate each pair, one removed judgment ambiguity by treating all beans as capable of growing.
n.quote:
The number of beans placed in the “+” tray for the remaining 26 par-
ticipants

replication.target_description: Classification of stimuli as good or bad in the pooled replication. Two-tailed single-sample t test of good-evaluation ratio versus .618; published 2012 article, p.187.

n.sample_role: Participants pooled across the three groups
n.exclusions: Five instruction violators excluded from 90; six who evaluated then placed all items into one bag retained.

reported_success.quote:
The results indicated that those in the wooden sphere and tile groups,
as well as across all three groups collectively, judged the items as “good”
in accordance to the predictions of V. A. Lefebvre’s mathematical model

notes:
Full primary source unavailable within bounded acquisition. DOI landing page returned HTTP 403 challenge (not retried); Unpaywall best_oa_location was null; OpenAlex best_oa_location was null and locations supplied no full text; Europe PMC identified the matching title but reported no PMC text or PDF. Targeted open-web searches including OSF and PsyArXiv found no full source. ResearchGate exposed only a first-page publisher preview, not the requested results page; preview and abstract values were not used. Supplied target: Classification of stimuli as good or bad in the pooled replication. Original locator: p. 578; p. 2 Replication locator: p. 187; p. 3. No narrative verdict inferred from abstracts or third-party citations.
Source follow-up: Rendered PDF p.187 checked. Narrative additionally cautions that individual data give less clear support; success records the authors’ target-group verdict. Pooled n=85 is explicitly printed in the sample-size test and agrees with listed group sizes.
Source follow-up: Original source only. The separate model-predicted-value test is t25 = 0.12, p = .907; η2 = .001; it is not the chance comparison extracted here. Target numerics verified on rendered primary PDF p. 2.
